verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for an always-on agent product, so the axis applies. However, the dots docs describe access only through ChatGPT (desktop and mobile), Slack, Teams, and calls. A runtime probe found no dots-specific public API, CLI, or MCP-server surface. The Codex CLI in the llms.txt index belongs to a separate product that dots can delegate to, so it is not a dots CLI.
